notes.decision: Translated as 'bond' — the unifying principle paired with ⲁⲅⲁⲡⲏ. The text identifies Love AS this ⲡϣⲱⲧ (line 1) and lists 'the two: the bond and the love' as one body (line 3-4). The lexeme is uncertain in Crum (cf. ϣⲱⲧ 'lack' or ϣⲱⲱⲧ 'cut, sever' — neither fits). Likely a Lycopolitan term meaning 'binding, joining, uniting principle'; chosen 'bond' captures the cosmological function of joining Greatness to land/Church without overcommitting to any specific etymology.

Read as ⲁⲡⲓⲱⲧ 'to the Father' — the line-break ⲁⲡⲓ̈|ϣⲧ shows unusual orthography of ϣⲧ for the standard ⲱⲧ. Manichaean cosmological context strongly favors 'the Father' as the antecedent of 'Master of the All, called Love.' The triadic identification 'Father / Master of the All / Love' is doctrinally standard. The orthographic ϣⲧ may reflect a scribal variant or dialectal feature.
'The Master of the All' — ⲧⲝⲁⲓ̈ⲥ is Lyc. for ϫⲟⲉⲓⲥ 'lord/master' (cf. accumulated ⲡⲁⲭⲁⲓ̈ⲥ 'Lord'); ⲡⲧⲏⲣϩ = ⲡⲧⲏⲣϥ 'the All' with regular Lyc. ϩ for ϥ.

'(He is) the face of the love' — ϩⲟ 'face, aspect' (cf. ⲡⲍⲟ in glossary). The Apostle as the visible/manifest face of agape within the Church, paralleling the cosmic-correspondential register: the Mind/Apostle IS the manifest aspect of Love at the ecclesiastical register, just as Love IS the bond at the Greatness register.

'It sinned against another power foreign (to it)' — ⲁⲕⲉϭⲁⲙ = ⲕⲉ-ϭⲁⲙ 'another power' (ϭⲁⲙ = ϭⲟⲙ 'power'); ϣⲙⲙⲟ 'stranger, foreign.' The Lyc. ⲁⲕⲉ for the indefinite article + ⲕⲉ- 'other.' Hatred is described as transgressing not only its own offspring but also a foreign power (the Light).

'Its share/portion' — ⲡⲱϩ here is the possessive ⲡⲱⲥ + Lyc. ϩ for ϥ giving 'his/its share' (cf. ⲡⲏϣⲉ 'share' in glossary). The phrase ⲡⲉⲧⲉ ⲡⲱϩ ⲉⲙ ⲡⲉ = 'that which is not its (own) share' = what is foreign/alien to it.

'From the' — ⲡⲓ-ⲁⲃⲁⲗ as compound demonstrative-directional 'this-out-of' = 'from the.' Recurs four times in the descending chain hatred → envy → devil → wicked one, marking each derivation. The repeated structure is a chain-of-genealogy formula common in Manichaean cosmology.
